title: The integral constructible category is O_E-linear with O_E-linear shift
statement: Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $Y$. The derived category $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] is $\mathcal O_E$-linear: $a\in\mathcal O_E$ acts on every Hom group through the ring map $\mathcal O_E=\varprojlim_n A_{E,n}\to\Gamma(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y})$ induced by the constant sections, composition is $\mathcal O_E$-bilinear, and the shift functors act $\mathcal O_E$-linearly. Consequently the full subcategory $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with the triangulated structure of [lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated], is an $\mathcal O_E$-linear triangulated category with $\mathcal O_E$-linear shift.

proof.text: Reuse the published canonical ambient structure integralCoefficientLinear on the definitionally identical scalarReductionSource. The theorem integralCoefficientLinear_existsUnique characterizes precisely its scalar action; Exists.choose_spec gives the constant-section formula for every ambient derived morphism. The constant-section construction and derived localization arguments of the original Steps 1-4 remain in that legacy interface rather than being repeated here.

Use integralCoefficientShift_linear for every integer n, with the same canonical ambient linear structure. This is the existing ambient shift-linearity clause of the node; no new scalar action or identification of completed and discrete coefficients is introduced.

The intrinsic sfIntegralConstructibleCategory is a full subcategory with the ambient Hom module structures. Mathlib fullSubcategoryInclusionLinear makes its inclusion linear. Use the recorded integral triangulation for its inherited shifts and the inclusion commShiftIso. Transfer linearity of inclusion followed by the ambient shift across this natural isomorphism using Functor.linear_of_iso, obtaining linearity of the subcategory shift followed by inclusion. Apply faithfulness of inclusion to map_smul to conclude linearity of the subcategory shift itself. Pair these four clauses to obtain sfIntegralConstructible_linear.
